thread:
incident-bot: URGENT: Pager triggered for ingress svc — spike in 5xx and TLS handshake failures across multiple regions. Affected: ~10% requests, ~600rps errors. Paging oncall.

oncall-alex: getting it. looking at logs now. any customer reports?

sre-jess: seeing a sharp rise in "tls: handshake failure" from envoy at the edge. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:31Z svc-ingress proxy ERROR "tls handshake error: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid"
count=598, region=us-west-2
```

eng-runtime: did anyone rotate certs this morning? I see a rotator job ran at 02:00 UTC.

deployer-bot: cert-rotator job completed: rotator/apply v3.4.2 -> success for leaf certs, intermediate update scheduled.

sre-jess: looks like the intermediate chain changed and some clients (mTLS) are failing to verify intermediate -> causing client-side aborts. Also gateways returning 502/524 for downstreams.

security-maya: mTLS truststore config hasn't been updated to include new intermediate hash. rolling update skipped due to dry-run flag.

oncall-alex: mitigation options?

sre-jess: immediate mitigations: 1) revert rotator to previous intermediate chain 2) enable fallback to legacy chain on LB for 10m 3) re-issue intermediate with cross-signed cert

eng-runtime: I can rollback the rotator in ~3m. Preparing rollback script:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/cert-rotator --to-revision=9
# verify chain
openssl s_client -connect ingress.redwood.ai:443 -showcerts
```

cs-linda: I will notify impacted customers in the affected org list (mTLS customers first). Drafting message.

oncall-alex: do the rollback. set LB fallback to legacy chain and throttle new rotations. Also enable verbose TLS logs for 15m.

sre-jess: rollback started.

deployer-bot: undo request accepted, rollout status: Rolling back to revision 9

sre-jess: LB fallback enabled on us-west-2 and eu-west-1. traffic draining for updated nodes.

eng-runtime: rollback complete. intermediate chain matches previous fingerprint: sha256:ABCD1234EFGH5678. verify logs show no new handshake fails.

sre-jess: monitoring — 5xx rate down from 10% -> 0.8% in last 5m. still seeing some lingering client timeouts for mTLS customers.

security-maya: will open a follow-up Jira to add guardrails to rotator to prevent dry-run false-positive. Also request KMS audit for signing key usage.

cs-linda: customer comms sent to 4 orgs: summary + mitigation + ETA for full resolution 60m. asking for any specific customer escalations.

oncall-alex: handing off to night oncall @oncall-ritesh in 20m — leaving runbook steps and escalation list.

oncall-alex: runbook note:
- rollback rotator if handshake errors >1% over 5m
- enable LB legacy fallback
- verify openssl chain and fingerprint
- notify cs for impacted customers

oncall-ritesh: ack. I'll keep monitoring. If errors spike again I'll trigger an incident SEV2 and request emergency cert re-issue.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Incident channel created: #incident-2104567890-ingress-ssl-expiry

sre-jess: post-mortem owner: eng-runtime; root cause likely misapplied intermediate chain during rotation without propagating truststore update to mTLS clients. follow-ups: rotator guardrail, deploy-time safety checks, customer compatibility tests.

cs-linda: ETA for full resolution moved to 30m. customers asking for logs — attaching anonymized handshake traces to ticket.

oncall-ritesh: monitoring dashboards look stable. continuing to watch. :thumbsup:
